name: How long does a kitchen drywall repair take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen drywall repair take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most minor kitchen drywall patches take one to two days to complete properly. While hanging the drywall patch takes very little time, joint compound requires several hours to dry between coats before it can be sanded and textured. Fast-setting hot mud can speed up the process, but standard drying times depend on your home's humidity and indoor temperature. Painting adds another step, often requiring primer plus one to two topcoats to blend completely with surrounding kitchen cabinetry and walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen drywall repairs take one to two days because multiple coats of compound and primer must dry completely between application, sanding, and texturing.
